reviews.text: I recommend Kinga wholeheartedly! ❤️ A very kind, reliable and conscientious cat sitter, Oti felt very comfortable with her. 🐱I would definitely trust her again next time, thank you very much for everything! 🥰 …
But it's good that you are here!
I definitely recommend it so that the cats don't stay alone, you can feel that a cat-loving sitter is taking care of them.

It was the first time we left our cat alone for a long time, so we were worried about it. That's why it was important to us that we really trusted people to leave our cat with, and we didn't have to be disappointed. LocalCat really provided a 5-star service. The sitters - Tünde and Zsófi - were fantastic. We could see from the moment they introduced themselves that Luna would be in the best hands. Every day we received a very detailed, personalized report, with many star photos of our little raisin.
They always paid attention to special needs, and they reported in detail on the developments and Luna's mood. The photos also showed how comfortable she felt with them, and the great purring, petting and playful running went well.
We can wholeheartedly recommend them to everyone, we will definitely meet again, because we know that our little favorite is in the best hands with them!
Once again, a huge thank you, Petra, Luna and Zsolti

This is my first time using a cat sitter, for a longer period of time. Seeing the previous reviews about Local Cat, I wasn't too nervous about leaving my precious little kitty at home :D She's not a heartbroken cat, she's a bit wild sometimes, but she got along really well with Emese, our sitter, and they quickly found common ground. The photo reports were extremely entertaining :) Thank you very much and I will definitely contact you again in the future when I travel :)

The time has come to look after Anti again. Everything happened according to the well-established scenario, we received the same reports and photos. We are very satisfied and have decided to use this excellent service in the future and recommend it to others. Just look how satisfied Anti is.
Alexa was an angel with our little girl. The status updates and pictures are a really lovely service. I'd hire her and LocalCat anytime again!

I couldn't have asked for a more caring, kinder, more professional service! I'm grateful that Bubi was treated so wonderfully and we were able to celebrate in peace. 🥰 Bianka is a fairy, and the Local Cat team is fair, reliable, and professional. I definitely recommend them if you need this kind of help with your cat!🙂

They looked after our cat Anti for 2 weeks in August and we were very satisfied with the service. Brigó and Imola treated the kitty with love and great care from the first moment. I loved that they sent a photo report of the visit every day. We were completely calm during the holiday that the kitten was in good hands. Correct, reliable service, I can only recommend it to everyone. If I could, I would rate it 10 stars. Thank you!🤗

At the last minute, I looked for them (there was no one who would have come), and luckily, they were able to take it on! We are very, very satisfied (both the kittens and me). The kittens have never been so good to anyone when I was away. They were really taken care of every day, not just kept alive. And these two very cowardly kittens also opened up to a stranger! I am so grateful! And it was so nice to receive the super cute letters with pictures every day!
You've been the best for 7 years! Thank you for always being there for us, and of course, Katia! 😻💜

We have used LocalCat's cat sitter services many times during our family trips. It is a very reassuring feeling that they receive careful daily care, lots of cuddles and playtime even when we are not home. Eszter even sits our tortoise alongside the cats. :)
Zsófi took care of my little kitty with amazing expertise and care while I was on vacation. She sent pictures and videos every day and reported on everything in detail. A true animal lover ❤️

For years they have helped us to keep my cat and I comfortable while I was away from our shared home.
The service is constantly evolving: new website, order form, online payment. Congratulations on your business.
I am extremely satisfied, very precise and thorough, helpful team!

We just left our cat Zserbó alone with a cat sitter, we were nervous about what the first day would be like, but Kinga came and looked after Zserbó so lovingly that we immediately felt at ease. In addition, we received lots of pictures and Kinga described Zserbó's morning in such detail that we were almost there with them...we are very grateful for all this and can travel with a calm heart in the future.

This is the first time I have used this service, but I am completely satisfied. Correct, completely reliable. Every day I received a photo report of how my cats behaved. It was a great feeling that I didn't have to worry, I could enjoy my vacation in peace. I was especially happy that our cat sitter not only took care of feeding and litter cleaning, but also played with the cats, so I think they also coped with their loneliness much more easily.
Edit took care of our skittish cat and she did an amazing job, we did not have to worry about a thing, great service, reliable and trustworthy. Thank you!
Tünde is a real fairy! She took care of my cat perfectly according to my request while I was away, she also sent pictures and a detailed report. I highly recommend them to everyone. 💖 …

They are available, kind, reliable, the cat sitter writes an email every day about how the cat is doing. They do everything as we discuss in detail beforehand, I am not worried about my cat because I know they will take care of it :)
I received very nice photos and a status report, everything went as planned. My cat was also very happy. I can only recommend it :)
A fair business, smooth administration and communication. Zsófi took great care of the cat and kept us informed about her condition with entertaining photo summaries. Thank you for everything!
I regularly ask for their help and I am glad they have it, I can safely entrust my cats to them. They are reliable, attentive, caring.

They have been taking care of our cat for a long time during our travels.
They are reliable, kind and our cat is happy that way. :)
We have been entrusting our cats to them for years, they are competent, reliable, really understand and love cats, they are cute sitters, I can only recommend them! <3

I was the first to ask them to sit for a few days. Kati takes great care of the cats and I received detailed information with pictures of my kitty every day 🤩 I will choose them next time 😊 I can only recommend them. …

Absolutely amazing service - really smooth and easy to book for the first time and flexible to arrange the initial meeting.  Gabo was absolutely wonderful with our cat, photos every day and patience to cuddle and play!  Booking our 2nd & 3rd times now for our next travel!

Reliable, excellently organized, the best we have ever entrusted our kittens to. Zsófi took care of our kittens, noted everything, paid attention to feeding (raw), habits, care. She played a lot with the kittens, wrote great summaries and sent photos. I can only recommend her!

It's been about six or seven years since I first chose them. There is no other Hungarian company that I would dare to recommend so highly. They have never made a mistake, the service and communication are perfect, and it is precisely because of Local Cat that I dare to travel with a calm heart.

Absolutely outstanding cat-sitting service!!
It was with great hesitation that I reached out to LocalCat to find someone to look after our cat, Abby, for the weekend. As any pet owner knows, leaving your fur baby with a stranger — and giving them access to your home — is a huge and anxious decision. But I am so glad I took the leap.

The response to my request was almost immediate, everything was handled professionally, and communication was excellent from start to finish. And then they sent us Balázs.

Wow. If you want the perfect cat sitter, ask for Balázs (I hope he covers your area!). His English was perfect, his communication was superb, and the updates and photos after each visit were amazing. For the first time in years, I didn’t stress for a single moment while away — Abby was in wonderful hands, our home was safe, and we actually had a stress-free holiday.

I highly recommend LocalCat and will continue using them for all future cat-sitting. Take the leap and book — you won’t regret it!
Dear Szandi! Thank you very much for your review, we are glad that you were satisfied with our service :)!
Dear Enikő, Thank you for your review :)!

When we travel somewhere we always entrust our cats to Localcat. We have met several of their sitters and so far we have only had positive experiences. Everyone took very good care of the cats, and we noticed that they quickly found a common ground with them. I especially like the emails that the sitters send after each visit. I can only recommend them, they have always been reliable and fair.

Hats off, really! The administration and the first meeting went quickly and smoothly. The sitter took care of our cat with such kindness and love as if it were her own. Professional team, we received pictures of our cat and a detailed report every day. They are always available, I knew my cat was in really good hands. We will definitely be looking for them again in the future and I can only recommend them 😻
Reliable, kind company, we were extremely satisfied!

Professional organization, reliable, safe.
The care of the kittens went smoothly, as agreed.
We received a photo report of the girls twice a day.
We will look for them again if necessary.
Thank you for your help 😻😻
Thanks to local cat we had a wonderful Holiday while our cat was in really good hands :)
They are fast, kind, reliable, professional. I felt safe with my cat :D
They are very kind, reliable, great :)

They are brilliant!
They send you a picture of your pets every day, as long as you provide the stuffing for the animals, they play with them, and clean up after them.

Once you have made contact, they will visit you for a routine check-up, prepare with you for the routine needed to care for your pets, and write down an emergency scenario in case they arrive in your absence and find that the animals are in some kind of trouble.

I highly recommend it!

Great team! Pocak's surrogate mother, Viki, is very kind. :) I leave my cat with her with complete peace of mind, because I know that she is in good hands and will receive her medicine. Every evening I receive the "report" with photos, which is also very fair and reassuring. I wholeheartedly recommend LocalCat to anyone who does not want to or cannot board their cat. I confess that the best place for cats is home. And Localcat is a great partner in this.
Fast service, flexible, kind and professional care for cats. A service that is indispensable for all cat owners. 😻 …

Very fair company, I felt I could trust them completely and our cat sitter confirmed this. The cats really liked it, even the otherwise very distrustful, difficult to make friends cat quickly accepted it and even looked forward to it. Everything was perfectly in order according to the agreement, and I think it exceeded expectations :) . After that, I organize any trip much more calmly.

The biggest relief is that when I have to go away, there are people who really take care of my cat, not only feeding it, but also playing with it, they understand why play is important, and they love cats. I always call them, even if the cat would probably pass without a problem, because it's not only important that it stays alive, but also that it's balanced ❤️❤️

Im very happy with the services from LocalCat, this is the second time I use them, and my cat is so well taken care of and the communication with the cat sitter has been great both times - highly recommendable!
Thank you for your rating and trust 😺! …
Every time I encountered kind, helpful administration and precision and care from the cat sitters. It was reassuring during the trips that my cats were in capable, loving hands.

We are very happy that we found the LocalCat team! We received extremely correct, precise, helpful, empathetic help on all three occasions when we asked for help with the care of our cat. Viki, who is a true treasure to us, with her extremely loving care, resourcefulness, and kindness, helped our extra scared, permanently ill Tigris cat a lot! Thus, the cat was safe, at home, and in great care, and we could live the days spent apart from each other in peace. We are grateful for the many efforts, the photos, videos, and detailed information! We will continue to ask for LocalCat's help!

If we are traveling and there is no one to take care of the cat, LocalCat is the only one! They come to the cat, so it doesn't cause him any stress. They love cats, they are flexible and we get a daily report on how the cat is doing, so we can travel with peace of mind.
